description: This file defines a class Upgrade8 within the Opencart framework, specifically for handling upgrade routines during the installation process. It performs database updates related to event code renaming, adding new default events, migrating trigger formats, and cleaning up deprecated event entries during the upgrade to version 8.

classes.name: Upgrade8
classes.description: Controller class responsible for executing specific upgrade routines for Opencart version 8 during system installation or upgrade process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that performs database and event updates required to upgrade the system to version 8.
